images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one painted FROST CAST VFX animation sprite sheet, square 1254 x 1254 pixels, exactly 2 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells, four frames in row-major order. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the icy blue-white energy at the character's staff tip, its faceted painted brushwork, hard illustrated edges and deep-blue falloff. Do not include any character, hand, staff, scenery, symbols, text or visible grid. Pure uniform BLACK #000000 background, bright energy only: an additive emission plate. Every effect centred exactly in its own cell with generous black padding; no glow or particle touches a cell boundary. Frame centers at normalized image coordinates (25%,25%), (75%,25%), (25%,75%), (75%,75%). No photographic mist, neon laser style or fire-like flames. Frames 0–3 of 8: top-left frame 0 a tiny gathering pale blue-white core with exactly 3 small angular ice fragments, total effect diameter 10% of the cell; top-right frame 1 a growing core with a few orbiting icy shards, total diameter 18%; bottom-left frame 2 a compact flare gathering bright layers, total diameter 28%; bottom-right frame 3 the peak crystalline cast flare with a brilliant pale-blue-white core and deep blue painted falloff, a few sharp shards pointing outward, total diameter 40%. Genuine temporal growth of ONE effect. HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game: confident hand-drawn tapered contours with varying weight, painted fills in clean planes, restrained surface texture, readable small silhouettes, no conspicuous grain. Each frame looks like a frame of hand-drawn animation. The frozen VFX edge language is carried by the reference's staff-tip energy only. No floor shadows. The requested black emission plate and centered VFX sheet layout apply to this asset.
